capability.summary: Simplify one SymPy expression or solve one lhs = rhs equation
capability.description: Parses a SymPy expression or a single lhs = rhs equation. Equations are normalized to lhs - rhs before simplification and sympy.solve; symbols are inferred by SymPy.
capability.problem_space: One-shot symbolic simplification and zero-finding for a SymPy-readable expression or equality.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one SymPy expression or lhs = rhs equation string; output: JSON echoing input with simplified and solved values serialized as strings.
accepted_inputs: an expression string accepted by sympy.sympify, or one lhs = rhs equation whose two sides are accepted by sympy.sympify
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.sympy_solve", input as the original expression string, simplified as str(sympy.simplify(expression)), and solved as str(sympy.solve(expression)). A caught sympify, simplification, or solving exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.sympy_solve", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: does not integrate or differentiate despite the original broad label
calls solve(expression) with no explicit variable, equation right-hand side, domain, assumptions, or solver options
treats the parsed expression as equal to zero and lets SymPy infer which symbols to solve for
stringifies both mathematical outputs, losing SymPy object types and structured solution shape
sympy.sympify is not intended for unsanitized untrusted input because it evaluates parsed expressions
parsing and symbolic-computation failures use the wrapper's error envelope and no timeout is imposed

output_contract.description: Original expression plus stringified SymPy simplification and implicit-zero solve results.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: solve an expression for its inferred symbols
negative_intents: solve with explicit domains assumptions or variable selection
return structured symbolic objects or numeric approximations
